notes.title: Build 3
notes.content:
build 2:
 - fixed major bug preventing windows user (and others) to play when a plugged controller could not be guessed
   (for me it was my usb sound card which was detected as an usb controller and was messing with the detection)

build 3:
 features:
    - launcher interface has been extended to provide all that is required for the user to:
     . report bugs
     . manage its configuration files
     . read the manual

 Bug:
    - (fixed) ... Go ... message shown before race. Mostly visible on solo, for the 3 first races.
    - (WIN) (workaround) launcher -> joystick config detecting no controller
    - (WIN) (workaround) some inputs were not detected by engine when using press as a trigger for action.
      Using release instead seems to work.
    - (fixed) Major. Solo play. Could launch locked races.
    - (fixed) starfield was updated multiple time. Overhaul revision of updater.
